coverage: Dated conversation excerpts and summaries, report, media, supplied firmware and builder clarification; not a complete chat or attachment export.
timeline_note: Dates identify discussions and evidence, not undocumented fabrication dates. Spacing is not proportional to elapsed time.

milestones.label: 6 NOV 2025
milestones.title: Define the game and the budget
milestones.detail: Control, torque, precision and speed; $150–200 planning limit. Compare layouts and seek obtainable propulsion.

milestones.label: 13–14 NOV 2025
milestones.title: Question the motor–propeller match
milestones.detail: 1360 versus 680 RPM; available 6 × 4E propeller. Assistant thrust estimates remain unmeasured.

milestones.label: 30 NOV 2025
milestones.title: Explain the chosen architecture
milestones.detail: Builder describes hull alternatives, rotating thrusters, rear boosters, fiberglass construction and weight trade-offs.

milestones.label: 20–21 DEC 2025
milestones.title: Preserve RC control; explore camera feedback
milestones.detail: Integrated receiver shared. Phone vision and practical motor-only following considered as a separate extension.

milestones.label: 18 OCT 2026 UTC
milestones.title: Clarify what the vision work demonstrated
milestones.detail: PC/laptop detection, ESP32 commands and motor response bench-tested. Autonomous water following remains untested.

milestones.label: 30 OCT 2026
milestones.title: Document the real packaging and failure
milestones.detail: Builder confirms XPS + hot glue + silicone and the final-round servo ingress failure. Sources are cross-checked.
